name: Biff
storyline:
Biff is a young chimp, In fact a very cheeky young chimp, who has been very rude to his mother. This was the last straw
his mother has had enough and she kicked him out of the family tree house. Well, Biff was quite surprised by this, He was also very cold and he didn't fancy sleeping the night out in the jungle by himself. Bifff thought of ways to get back into the tree house, but the only sound idea was to be extremely nice to his mother.

To do this Biff set about doing various tasks around the jungle.
summary:
You must control Biff around the jungle, performing tasks to please your mother.

Tasks should be completed in order , to help you with this
Tthe object that is flashing is the object to be used next..

There are also comments in the display box that give you hints on what to do next.
